summary: Initial volume-based strategy: book many cheap $80 half-days, prioritize weekends, commit PTO for weekdays.
describe: Book many cheap half-day trips ($80 PM, AM, twilight) to maximize volume. Prioritize weekends (free PTO). Commit PTO strategically for high-catch weekdays. Use 14-day forecast of catches (from recent trips data) to pick days. Target 20-25 trips per season to outfish premium-trip competitors. Cost per fish matters more than individual trip size.
